title: a second consumer, to find what is still shaped by the first
acceptance_criteria: a project that is not the original consumer builds a working two-tab page on ui_base without editing any file under ui_base/assets
notes: one consumer cannot tell you what is general. The demo is a weak second consumer - it was written by the same hand, on the same day, against the same assumptions. A private project's image-classification work is the real candidate.

title: no test suite yet
acceptance_criteria: read_asset's traversal refusal is pinned by a test, and a headless check asserts the demo page's scripts parse and every API it calls exists
notes: checked BY HAND on extraction day and both passed: ../pyproject.toml and a url-encoded traversal both 404, and every function and section kind the demo uses exists with matching option names. Hand-checked is not pinned - the demo drifting from the assets is the failure that would make the README quietly wrong. DONE 2026-09-02. tests/test_assets.py, 16 tests. Three groups, one per failure this package can actually have: serving what it should not (traversal, symlink escape, all parametrised), failing to serve what a consumer links (EXPECTED named explicitly, never globbed - a test that reads the directory it checks passes on an empty directory), and shipping broken assets (node --check on every script; every var() resolves to a token the file defines; every token exists on bare :root, since the default 'system' theme stamps no attribute and a token defined only under a media query is undefined for most viewers).
